title: Wakeup Output Simplification — Binary work choice
one_liner: When work queue exists, simplify wakeup briefing to single offer: 'Complete workable items | Refine backlog' — reduce cognitive load, clear next action.
summary: Current wakeup briefing shows: project state, all active lugs, teachings, signals, context health, recommendations. Too much. When queue is populated (via auto-discovery or user), simplify to: 'Ready work queue: N items (Haiku-completable). Refine backlog: M items (needs_refinement). Your choice: [W]ork / [R]efine / [S]kip'? Clean binary choice, reduce noise, clarify path forward.
motivation: Clarity + low cognitive load. User wakes up, sees queue, picks work or refinement. No digging through lugs list. 'What should I do?' is answered instantly.
key_distinction: Workable items = items marked 'ready' in queue that meet Haiku complexity threshold (completable by sub-agent in one session, <10 steps, clear acceptance criteria)
acceptance_criteria: Wakeup Step 7 (new sub-section): Queue-based briefing mode (if queue exists)
- Context health (1 line: '48% context (YELLOW) — plan remaining work')
- Queue summary (2 lines): 'Workable: N items | Refine backlog: M items'
Skip full lug list, teaching discovery, signal review (those are inside queue management)
If no queue exists: fall back to current full briefing (normal wakeup output)
Define 'Haiku-completable': <10 steps, clear acceptance_criteria, no blockers, estimated <30 mins execution
scope: Wakeup Step 7: Conditional logic — if queue exists, show simplified briefing
Queue metadata: add `workable: boolean` flag per item (auto-calculated from criteria)
Briefing display: collapse to 4 lines + offer, hide lug details
Define complexity thresholds (steps, time, criteria quality)
out_of_scope: Auto-marking readiness (user decision or explicit flag)
implementation_notes: Simplification is presentation-layer only. Queue structure unchanged. Clarity via reduction.
scope_verified_by: user request (Session 73: 'wakeup output should leverage it to make the simple offer to the user - complete workable items; refine backlog')
routing_notes: UX/simplification feature for queue orchestration system. Feeds into epic-ozi-work-queue-orchestration-v1 + epic-ozi-queue-auto-discovery-v1.
resolution_note: Implemented: Session 102 added binary briefing (W/R/S), needs-you bucket, conditional simplified format, slim wakeup (lazy-load skills+lugs), and minimal mode.
